title: Population near the Isiolo–Mandera corridor
route: Isiolo–Mandera via El Wak, Wargadud and Rhamu

source.product: WorldPop R2025A, constrained, UN-adjusted, 1 km, v1
source.method: Integer pixel window copied without resampling. Original Float32 count values, no-data and grid alignment retained.

limitations: 10 km is a chosen straight-line analytical width on each side, not a universal project catchment, travel distance or measured access.
Counts are modelled WorldPop 2025 estimates, not a census or project beneficiary count.

Partially intersected 1 km cells are allocated by overlap area in Mollweide, assuming uniform population within each source cell. Polygon overlays use a shared 1 mm coordinate precision to avoid floating-point topology errors. No raster resampling.
Raster no-data, negative and nonfinite values are excluded and their area coverage reported; valid zero cells remain zero.
Country boundaries are the existing map boundaries; small overlaps and gaps are kept as unassigned rather than guessed.
Corridor follows mapped OSM geometry checked against the KeNHA route via El Wak and Rhamu; mapping completeness and alignment can affect estimates.

This is a constrained settlement-based population model. The area occupied by valid-valued cells is not a population-coverage percentage. Settlement mapping errors can misallocate population. R2025A was released as an alpha product.

validation.checks: Original-cell overlaps; independent Cluster and country allocation; unassigned gaps/overlaps retained; nodata excluded and reported. Shared 1 mm coordinate precision for stable polygon overlays; source cell values are not resampled.

comparison_to_existing_healthcare_total.note: Independent original-cell allocation; not forced to match the existing summary.

route_validation.source: Returned QGIS centreline from Kenya Geofabrik roads, kenya-260623-free.shp.zip
route_validation.route: Isiolo–Mandera via El Wak, Wargadud and Rhamu
route_validation.correction: Removed the unique merged branch matching the attributed Khorof Harar–Kutulo Road (old B9), which is not the named corridor. No new connecting lines were drawn.
route_validation.extent: Source centreline covers the cluster plus 15 km halo; the analysis buffer is 10 km. Clipping to the wider halo cannot truncate the band within the cluster.
route_validation.distance_method: 10,000 m buffer in local azimuthal equidistant CRS centred at 3N, 41E; 96 segments per quadrant; clipped to cluster; area allocation in Mollweide ESRI:54009
route_validation.status: Geometry and named-route anchor checks passed; see route_review.png
